title: Sanctus (Holy, Holy, Holy)
text:
Holy, Holy, Holy Lord God of hosts.
Heaven and earth are full of your glory.
Hosanna in the highest.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.
Hosanna in the highest.

translation.latin:
Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus
Dominus Deus Sabaoth.
Pleni sunt caeli et terra gloria tua.
Hosanna in excelsis.
Benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini.
Hosanna in excelsis.

notes: The Sanctus is sung or recited during every Mass just before the Eucharistic Prayer. It combines the song of the angels from Isaiah's vision with the acclamation of the crowds welcoming Jesus into Jerusalem.
